_comment: NOCTHOLLOW - the night planet. A walk-and-wonder world (no goal, no puzzle): a night that never ends and a land that glows to fill it. Eight regions ring the Lumen Mere (a luminous lake): the Landing (where you arrive), Glowcap Wood, Elder Hollow, the Breathing Fen, the Crystal Steppe, the Skyward Rise and the Bellbloom Meadow, linked by glowing moss-veins. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): night palette, glowing mushroom-trees / Lumen Elders / crystal spires / bell-flowers / spore-stalks (tree entries [x, y, kind]), luminous water, prop lights, a slow aurora day-cycle, and actor_look - the palette shift + glow its visitors wear. Native creatures (lumejelly, glimmerhop, stiltwhisk, driftray, lanternsnail) are ambient pals; their lore and temperament live in data/pals.json. Props with 'flare': true blaze up when touched, relayed to everyone in the world. Generated by tools/gen_nocthollow_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_nocthollow.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: The air hums, and everything glows. Wander, look closer, and touch the light — your footsteps will shine.

props.label: a humming rune-stone
props.lore: The runes on this stone glow a little brighter as you come near, as if it's been expecting visitors. The air hums very softly.

props.label: a fallen star
props.lore: A piece of fallen star, half-buried in the moss and still warm. The rocks around it have been glowing gold for longer than anyone remembers.

props.label: a bench of pale fungus-wood
props.lore: A bench grown rather than built, from pale, springy fungus-wood. From here you can see the light of the Mere spilling over the hill.

props.label: a cushion of starmoss
props.lore: Starmoss: soft as a pillow and faintly warm. Every footstep across it leaves a little print of light behind.

props.label: a shore-stone
props.lore: The water here never ripples on its own. It glows from somewhere deep down, steady as a held breath.

props.label: a fungus-wood bench
props.lore: Someone grew this bench to face the water. Sit long enough and the lights in the Mere seem to drift into slow constellations.

props.label: a floating lily-light
props.lore: A lily-light, floating out on the Mere. Its bud opens and closes slowly, glowing a little brighter each time it opens.

props.label: the heart-stone
props.lore: The old stones stand in a ring, all leaning toward the Elders. If you hold still, you can hear the trees creak, slow as breathing.

props.label: moss over the Elder's roots
props.lore: The Elders' glowing tendrils sway even when there's no wind, as if they're feeling for something.

props.label: a fairy-ring of glowcaps
props.lore: A perfect circle of glowcaps. Touch one and the whole ring brightens, one cap after the next, all the way round.

props.label: a curl-fern
props.lore: Curl-ferns open at night. Here it's always night, so they never quite finish uncurling.

props.label: a shimmering trail on the moss
props.lore: A lanternsnail went by here not long ago. Its trail on the moss is still glowing faintly.

props.label: a breathing vent
props.lore: The ground here breathes. Every so often the vent sighs out a cloud of glowing spores, and they drift up like slow snow falling the wrong way.

props.label: a giant puffball
props.lore: Touch it and — fwump — it puffs out a little cloud of glowing spores, then puffs itself back up again.

props.label: a sunken stone
props.lore: The pools are warm. Lanternsnails come here to rest, and the whole fen dims and brightens with them, like a slow pulse.

props.label: a singing shard
props.lore: Brush the crystals and they ring, high and clear. Their notes take a long time to fade out across the steppe.

props.label: a weathered stone
props.lore: The crystals out here grow so slowly that this cluster has likely been here since before the first moon rose.

props.label: a sky-stone
props.lore: The runes are a map of the sky: two moons and a scatter of stars. One of the moons on it is marked with a tiny glowing dot.

props.label: a star-shard
props.lore: This high up you can see the whole of the Mere glowing below, like a second sky lying on the ground.

props.label: a lookout bench
props.lore: A good place to watch the driftrays. They circle up here in slow rings, their tails trailing light.

props.label: a lumen-bloom
props.lore: A lumen-bloom. Touch it and it flares bright. Everyone nearby will see it light up, then fade slowly back to a soft glow.

props.label: a garden-stone
props.lore: The bell-flowers here chime when a stiltwhisk brushes past. It sounds like very faraway music.

props.label: a lumen-bloom
props.lore: The lumen-bloom flares at your touch, and everyone nearby will see it glow.

props.label: a lumen-bloom
props.lore: It flares, bright as a struck match, then slowly settles back down.

props.label: a lumen-bloom
props.lore: The light ripples out from your hand and over the petals.

props.label: a lumen-bloom
props.lore: It brightens, and the blooms around it seem to lean in.
